svg.text: ATOM LITE + LD2410C · V5.1 desktop mount
Standing or shelf base • sliding cradle with lower bearing pads
Orange: cradle Yellow: Atom keeper Cream: radar keeper
Lower the mast into the base socket.
Use the base key only if loose; do not force it.
Fit the clamp over the shelf; advance its wedge by hand.
Reference shelf thickness: 12 mm; adjust before printing.
2 LOWER THE CRADLE INTO ITS GUIDES
The lower pads bear against the upright mast rails.
Slide the keeper in from the front until its tooth engages.
Align both guides; lower the cradle about 6.3 mm.
Trial fit with USB plugged in. Do not bend the guides.
Teal: 10 × 5 × 30 mm plug inside a larger clearance.
Purple: illustrative route; check actual cable slack.
Turn the radar both ways without pulling its connectors.
Trial fit without electronics first. The printed V5 fits; finger access to the Atom button remains cramped.
